cunning_stunt.name: Cunning Stunt
cunning_stunt.description: Use Cunning instead of Presence for Cool checks.

finesse.name: Finesse
finesse.description: Use Agility instead of Brawn for Brawl or Melee checks.

tenacious.name: Tenacious
tenacious.description:
Upgrade the number of advantages needed to score a critical hit
against the target a number of times equal to his ranks in Tenacious. Also, reduce a Critical Injury result he suffers by 10 per rank of Tenacious

tor_cartel_license.name: Cartel License
tor_cartel_license.description: While on a civilized world the character does not suffer legal repercussions from being in the possession of restricted equipment. They can however still be arrested or otherwise persecuted for using any such equipment in an unlawful manner.

tor_freedom_in_victory.name: Freedom in Victory
tor_freedom_in_victory.description: The character may perform the Freedom in Victory maneuver and commit [FO]. When the character would become immobilized or staggered, they may instead suffer 2 strain to not be affected.

tor_reckless_charge.name: Reckless Charge
tor_reckless_charge.description: After using a maneuver to engage an adversary, the character may suffer 2 strain to use this talent. They then add [SU][SU][TH][TH] to the results of the next Brawl, Melee, or Lightsaber check they make this turn.

tor_rule_by_fear.name: Rule by Fear
tor_rule_by_fear.description: The character removes [SE] per rank of Rule by Fear from their Leadership and Coercion checks.

tor_imperial_valor_improved.name: Imperial Valor (Improved)
tor_imperial_valor_improved.description: May spend [AD][AD] to increase strain threshold of one ally affected by Imperial Valor by 1 for the remainder of the encounter.

tor_deferred_blame.name: Deferred Blame
tor_deferred_blame.description: Once per session, take the Deferred Blame action; make an Average ([DI][DI]) Deception check to shift the blame for a mistake this character made to another person.
